description: This header defines the absl::BitGenRef class, a type-erasing, non-owning reference interface for various random bit generators, supporting both Abseil and standard library generators.

classes.name: BitGenRef
classes.description: A type-erasing, non-owning reference class for various random bit generators supporting both Abseil and standard library generators.
